id: 03_pH Maintenance How to maintain an Orion pH electrode
title: pH电极的维护保养
source_doc: course/General Lab Safety Practices/03_pH Maintenance How to maintain an Orion pH electrode.md
author_source: project/General Lab Safety Practices/03_pH Maintenance How to maintain an Orion pH electrode/src.py

points.K7: 快流式电极：排空内充液
points.K8: 快流式电极：加满并每日补液
points.K10: 普通可填充电极：吸出内充液
points.K11: 普通可填充电极：加满并每日检查

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，手里拿着一支pH电极
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench holding a slim pH electrode and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲pH电极的日常维护。

shots.scene: 日常维护、快流式电极、可填充电极三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a calendar with a check mark, an electrode with a small drip at its tip, and an electrode with a side fill hole and a dropper bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 每天要做的事，再加两种电极的换液方法。

shots.scene: 阿杰盯着pH计皱眉，屏幕数字一直在跳
shots.prompt_en: The young male student frowns at a benchtop pH meter whose blank display keeps flickering.
shots.narration: 阿杰测样品，读数又慢又飘。

shots.scene: 电极下端的保存瓶几乎空了，球泡露在外面
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a pH electrode in a small storage bottle that is almost empty, the glass bulb exposed to air. No people.
shots.narration: 原来保存瓶快干了，球泡露在空气里。

shots.scene: 电极侧面加液孔处的内充液液面很低
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the side of a refillable electrode showing the inner liquid level far below the fill hole. No people.
shots.narration: 内充液也只剩一小截。

shots.scene: 小研走过来，指着电极和两只空白标签的瓶子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over and points to the electrode and two bottles with blank labels.
shots.narration: 小研说：电极要天天照顾，才测得准。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and nods encouragingly.
shots.narration: 我们从每天的维护说起。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起电极，旁边浮现闪电、靶心、闪光三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up an electrode; a lightning icon, a target icon and a sparkle icon float beside it.
shots.narration: 维护电极，是为了让它反应快、读数准。

shots.scene: 干净的球泡和沾着污点的球泡对比，后者被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two electrode bulbs side by side: a clean shiny bulb with a green check and a smudged dirty bulb crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 还要保持清洁，不被污染。

shots.scene: 小研走进实验室，看向电极架
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks into the lab in the morning and looks at an electrode stand on the bench.
shots.narration: 每天进实验室，第一步先取出电极。

shots.scene: 手先拧开电极下端保存瓶的瓶盖
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand unscrews the cap of a small storage bottle fitted on the lower end of a pH electrode. No people.
shots.narration: 先拧松保存瓶的瓶盖。

shots.scene: 电极缓慢地从保存瓶中抽出
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand slowly draws the electrode up out of the small storage bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 再慢慢抽出电极。

shots.scene: 猛地拔出电极、瓶内出现吸力箭头的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an electrode yanked quickly out of a bottle with suction arrows inside, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 抽得太快会形成负压，要慢。

shots.scene: 电极侧面的加液孔高亮
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the side of a pH electrode with the small fill hole highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 用前要把内充液加满，先找到侧面加液孔。

shots.scene: 小研打开加液孔，用小滴瓶往里加液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens the fill hole and squeezes fill solution from a small dropper bottle with a blank label into it.
shots.narration: 用这支电极规定的填充液。

shots.scene: 内充液液面升到加液孔下沿
shots.prompt_en: Cutaway view of the electrode as the inner liquid level rises up to just below the fill hole. No people.
shots.narration: 一直加到加液孔的位置。

shots.scene: 电极插在烧杯中，内液面和样品液面之间标出距离
shots.prompt_en: Cutaway diagram of the electrode standing in a beaker of sample; a bracket marks the gap between the higher inner liquid level and the lower sample level. No people.
shots.narration: 内液面要比样品液面高出约一英寸。

shots.scene: 小研把电极夹到电极架上，准备测样
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student clips the filled electrode onto the electrode stand above a sample beaker.
shots.narration: 加满之后，就可以开始测样品了。

shots.scene: 日历上一个月里圈出两天
shots.prompt_en: A blank monthly calendar with two days circled. No people.
shots.narration: 保存液每月至少换两次。

shots.scene: 小研把旧保存液倒掉
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tips the old storage solution out of the small storage bottle.
shots.narration: 先把旧保存液倒掉。

shots.scene: 小研往保存瓶里挤去离子水
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student squirts deionized water from a wash bottle into the empty storage bottle.
shots.narration: 用去离子水涮洗保存瓶。

shots.scene: 小研盖住瓶口摇一摇，倒掉，再重复
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student swirls the rinse water in the storage bottle, pours it into the waste beaker, and repeats.
shots.narration: 摇一摇倒掉，反复几次，洗净旧液。

shots.scene: 两瓶空白标签的保存液，其中一瓶有对勾
shots.prompt_en: Two storage solution bottles with blank labels; one gets a green check mark matching an electrode icon. No people.
shots.narration: 选这支电极适用的保存液。

shots.scene: 小研往保存瓶里倒保存液，瓶身刻度过半
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours fresh storage solution into the small storage bottle until it is more than half full.
shots.narration: 加到保存瓶容积的六成以上。

shots.scene: 电极球泡整个浸在保存液里，闪着光
shots.prompt_en: Cutaway view of the electrode tip with the whole glass bulb fully submerged in storage solution, glowing softly. No people.
shots.narration: 整个玻璃球泡都要泡在保存液里。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着浸没的球泡竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the submerged glass bulb and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 球泡才能保持干净、灵敏。

shots.scene: 保存瓶瓶盖松松地套在电极上
shots.prompt_en: A small storage bottle cap sits loosely on the electrode body above the bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 放回时，瓶盖先松松套在电极上。

shots.scene: 电极缓缓滑进保存瓶
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand slides the electrode gently down into the storage bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 把电极轻轻滑进保存瓶。

shots.scene: 电极到位后拧紧瓶盖
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand tightens the bottle cap once the electrode is fully inside. No people.
shots.narration: 插到位后，再拧紧瓶盖。

shots.scene: 加液孔盖上小盖，旁边一个月亮图标
shots.prompt_en: The fill hole on the electrode side is closed with its small cover; a crescent moon icon floats beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 过夜保存，记得盖住加液孔。

shots.section_title: 快流式电极：排空内充液
shots.scene: 欣欣举起一支尖端有小水滴的电极
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up an electrode with a tiny drip at its lower junction.
shots.narration: 再看快流式电极怎样排液和重灌。
overlay: 快流式电极：排空内充液

shots.section_title: 快流式电极：排空内充液
shots.scene: 电极剖面：外套管处有一圈液体缓缓渗出
shots.prompt_en: Cutaway diagram of an electrode with a sleeve junction at the bottom, a thin ring of liquid slowly seeping out. No people.
shots.narration: 这类参比电极的液接处，一直在少量出液。

shots.section_title: 快流式电极：排空内充液
shots.scene: 小研缓慢取下电极下端的保存瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slowly removes the storage bottle from the lower end of the electrode.
shots.narration: 同样慢慢取出电极，别形成负压。

shots.section_title: 快流式电极：排空内充液
shots.scene: 电极悬在贴空白标签的废液杯上方
shots.prompt_en: The electrode is held above a plastic waste beaker with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 拿到废液杯上方操作。

shots.section_title: 快流式电极：排空内充液
shots.scene: 小研打开加液孔，按压电极顶部
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens the fill hole and presses down on the top of the electrode with her thumb over the waste beaker.
shots.narration: 打开加液孔，按住电极顶部。

shots.section_title: 快流式电极：排空内充液
shots.scene: 内充液从下端流入废液杯，液面逐渐降到底
shots.prompt_en: Liquid drains from the bottom of the electrode into the waste beaker while the inner level drops to empty. No people.
shots.narration: 直到内充液全部排进废液杯。

shots.section_title: 快流式电极：加满并每日补液
shots.scene: 倒置的填充液瓶尖嘴对准侧面加液孔
shots.prompt_en: An upside-down fill solution bottle with a blank label has its nozzle aimed at the side fill hole of the electrode. No people.
shots.narration: 用规定的填充液，从加液孔加进去。
overlay: 快流式电极：加满并每日补液

shots.section_title: 快流式电极：加满并每日补液
shots.scene: 内充液一直加到顶
shots.prompt_en: Cutaway view of the electrode as the inner liquid fills all the way up to the top. No people.
shots.narration: 一直加满到顶。

shots.section_title: 快流式电极：加满并每日补液
shots.scene: 日历每一天都有一个小滴瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: A weekly calendar strip where each day shows a small dropper bottle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 它天天在出液，每天用前都要补满。

shots.scene: 小研用洗瓶冲洗电极外壁，冲洗水流进废液杯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student rinses the outside of the electrode with a wash bottle of deionized water over the waste beaker.
shots.narration: 外壁沾了填充液，用去离子水冲净。

shots.scene: 两个箭头分别指向保存瓶和样品烧杯
shots.prompt_en: Two arrows from a clean electrode: one to a small storage bottle, one to a sample beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 然后放回保存，或者直接测样品。

shots.section_title: 普通可填充电极：吸出内充液
shots.scene: 欣欣拿着一支玻璃外壳的电极
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a glass-bodied refillable electrode with a side fill hole.
shots.narration: 普通可填充电极，要把内充液吸出来。
overlay: 普通可填充电极：吸出内充液

shots.section_title: 普通可填充电极：吸出内充液
shots.scene: 小研取出电极，指着侧面加液孔
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes the electrode out of its storage bottle and points to the side fill hole.
shots.narration: 取出电极，找到侧面的加液孔。

shots.section_title: 普通可填充电极：吸出内充液
shots.scene: 废液杯旁放着一支一次性塑料吸管
shots.prompt_en: A disposable plastic transfer pipette lies beside a waste beaker with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 准备废液杯和一次性吸管。

shots.section_title: 普通可填充电极：吸出内充液
shots.scene: 吸管尖轻轻插进加液孔
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand gently inserts the tip of the plastic pipette into the electrode fill hole. No people.
shots.narration: 吸管尖轻轻插进加液孔。

shots.section_title: 普通可填充电极：吸出内充液
shots.scene: 电极在废液杯上方倒过来，内充液聚到加液孔一侧
shots.prompt_en: Over the waste beaker, the electrode is turned upside down so the inner liquid gathers near the fill hole. No people.
shots.narration: 把电极倒过来，内充液更好吸。

shots.section_title: 普通可填充电极：吸出内充液
shots.scene: 吸管一次次把液体吸出，挤进废液杯
shots.prompt_en: The pipette draws the liquid out and empties it into the waste beaker, again and again, until the electrode is empty. No people.
shots.narration: 反复吸出，直到吸不出为止。

shots.section_title: 普通可填充电极：吸出内充液
shots.scene: 小研在废液杯里轻轻甩动电极，手握得很牢
shots.prompt_en: Inside the waste beaker, the female graduate student, wearing goggles, holds the electrode firmly and gives it a small gentle shake, facing away.
shots.narration: 剩几滴吸不出，可在杯里轻轻甩出。

shots.section_title: 普通可填充电极：加满并每日检查
shots.scene: 填充液瓶尖嘴插进加液孔
shots.prompt_en: The nozzle of a fill solution bottle with a blank label is inserted into the electrode fill hole. No people.
shots.narration: 加液瓶尖嘴插进加液孔。
overlay: 普通可填充电极：加满并每日检查

shots.section_title: 普通可填充电极：加满并每日检查
shots.scene: 内腔充满内充液
shots.prompt_en: Cutaway view of the glass electrode as its inner chamber fills completely. No people.
shots.narration: 把电极内腔加满。

shots.section_title: 普通可填充电极：加满并每日检查
shots.scene: 小研每天早上举起电极，对光查看液面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the electrode up to the light each morning to check the inner liquid level.
shots.narration: 每天用前确认内腔是满的。

shots.section_title: 普通可填充电极：加满并每日检查
shots.scene: 欣欣指着闪亮的读数靶心
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a glowing target icon next to a pH meter with a blank display.
shots.narration: 这样测出来的结果才最好。

shots.section_title: 普通可填充电极：加满并每日检查
shots.scene: 电极加满后夹回电极架，旁边保存瓶和样品杯
shots.prompt_en: The refilled electrode is clipped back onto the electrode stand, with a storage bottle and a sample beaker beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 加满后，测样或放回保存都可以。

shots.scene: 阿杰换好保存液、加满内充液，读数稳定，他笑了
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, wearing goggles and gloves, smiles as the pH meter display holds steady with the freshly refilled electrode.
shots.narration: 阿杰照着做，读数又快又稳了。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现保存瓶和加液孔图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a storage bottle and an electrode fill hole.
shots.narration: 每天慢取电极，用前加满内充液。

shots.scene: 日历和没过球泡的保存液图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a calendar and an electrode bulb submerged in storage solution. No people.
shots.narration: 保存液定期换，球泡要泡没。

shots.scene: 按压排液和吸管吸液两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: a thumb pressing the top of an electrode, and a pipette drawing liquid from a fill hole. No people.
shots.narration: 快流式按压排液，可填充用吸管吸。

shots.scene: 洗瓶冲电极、保存瓶和样品杯图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a wash bottle rinsing an electrode, a storage bottle and a sample beaker in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 冲净外壁，测样或放回保存。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整洁的实验台前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera in front of a tidy lab bench with an electrode stand.
shots.narration: 电极照顾好，数据才可靠，下次见！
